qualifications.description: The controller corrected a mistaken FANG expansion against the actual transcript before inventory acceptance and primary review. Original notes/manifest/plan preserved; same inventory context reread all changed inputs. No accepted judgment changed.
An unrecognized topic category was corrected to the current catalog category before primary judging. Old authorization and manifest preserved; no source or assessment substance changed.

Two unsaved inventory candidates were source-reviewed, preserved and corrected within the original context before its one accepted save. Corrections addressed actual targets, load-bearing coverage, complete quotations and preauthorized row-capacity reasons.

An original checked full candidate was recovered exactly from the immutable tool-call builder after failed handoff. SHA-256 matched the original checker receipt. The compact regeneration attempted later by the agent was not used. No new inference, rating choice, context or saved retry occurred.

The reviewer read a generic procedural skill outside the plan before authoring; it contained no debate evidence or peer/scores. The deviation was reviewed and documented before continuing the same context.

The writer prematurely reported complete reading after redirecting part of its reader to /dev/null. Authentication rejected it before authoring. The missing text was subsequently read visibly in the same context and full current-plan authentication passed.

isolationClaim: Procedural input and output isolation with tool-access inspection and literal-reading authentication; not an operating-system sandbox.
